nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. A Bell matrix over $R$ is given by a formal power series $g \in R[[X]]$ whose constant coefficient is a unit of $R$. The corresponding Riordan-array pair is $(g, Xg)$.
nodes.title: Bell matrix

nodes.summary: Let $g \in \mathbb{Z}[[X]]$ be the power series of a Bell matrix over $\mathbb{Z}$, with constant coefficient $g(0) = 1$, and let $u \in \mathbb{Z}[[X]]$ be a power series with constant coefficient $0$ such that substituting $u$ for $X$ in $X \, g(X)^{-1}$ gives $X$. Then for every natural number $n$, the entry of the Bell matrix in row $2n$ and column $n$ equals $(n+1)$ times the coefficient of $X^{n+1}$ in $u$.
nodes.title: Central coefficients of Bell matrices

nodes.summary: For a Bell matrix over a commutative ring $R$ given by the power series $g$, and natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the entry in row $n$ and column $k$ is the coefficient of $X^n$ in $g \cdot (Xg)^k$.
nodes.title: Entries of a Bell matrix

nodes.summary: For a Bell matrix over a commutative ring $R$ given by the power series $g$, the second component of its Riordan-array pair is the power series $h = Xg \in R[[X]]$.
nodes.title: Second component of a Bell matrix

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
